summary: Jason Pede, 31, of Chesterton, Indiana, was trapped three days when his Lincoln Navigator got stuck in hood-deep snow on a county road off Highway 114 northwest of Saguache in the Rio Grande National Forest. He was driving from Dulce, N.M. to Aspen to deliver an Australian Shepherd rescue puppy and took a 'shortcut' a local suggested; he survived on Mountain Dew and snow and burned vehicle items for warmth. After the SUV ran out of gas he hiked ~7 miles to a road and flagged down motorists on Sunday morning; sheriff's deputies returned to the vehicle and rescued the dog. Both man and dog uninjured.
location: county road off Highway 114, northwest of Saguache, Rio Grande National Forest
